hero.headline: Turn your Los Angeles garage into a fully finished ADU.
hero.lede: A legal, permitted studio or one-bedroom unit built inside the garage you already have. We handle feasibility, design, engineering, permits and construction under one contract.

included.title: A turnkey conversion
included.lede: One contract covers the whole conversion, from the first site visit to final sign-off.

items.title: Feasibility review
items.text: Setbacks, parking, utility capacity and existing structure checked before you spend on design.

items.title: Design & drawings
items.text: Floor plan, 3D renderings and permit drawings for the unit.

items.title: Engineering
items.text: Structural and energy compliance coordinated with licensed engineers.

items.title: Permits & inspections
items.text: Plan check submission, corrections, and every inspection through final.

items.title: Utilities
items.text: Electrical, water, gas and sewer planned and connected, including panel upgrades when needed.

items.title: Finishes
items.text: Kitchen or kitchenette, full bath, flooring, lighting and paint in your chosen finish level.

sizes.title: Three sizes, real ranges
sizes.lede: Ranges reflect typical Los Angeles garage conversions. Your number is set in writing after a walkthrough.
sizes.note: Where your project falls in a range depends on the factors below. Every proposal lists named allowances for selections and a written exclusions page, so the price you sign is the price you plan around.

items.title: Utility distance
items.text: How far water, sewer and power have to run from the main house.

items.title: Existing structure
items.text: Slab condition, framing, and whether the garage needs foundation or wall work.

items.title: Electrical capacity
items.text: Whether the main panel can carry a second unit or needs an upgrade.

items.title: Finish level
items.text: Standard or Premium cabinetry, counters, tile, flooring and fixtures.

items.a: Most attached and detached garages in Los Angeles can be, but it depends on the structure, setbacks and utilities. The walkthrough answers this before you commit to design.

items.q: Do I need to replace the lost parking?
items.a: California law generally does not require replacement parking when a garage is converted to an ADU. We confirm the rules for your property during feasibility.
Yes. A permitted ADU can be rented as a separate unit, which is why many owners build one for income.
We do. We prepare the drawings, submit for plan check, respond to corrections and schedule every inspection.

items.q: Why a range instead of a fixed price?
items.a: Two garages of the same size can need very different utility and structural work. After the walkthrough, you get a written fixed scope and price for your property.
